FinalClassification: TemplateStyles delivery implemented; authorization verification partial.
ExecutionScope: Repository implementation and disposable-free regression tests; no production or live MediaWiki execution

IntegrationDesign.PageAdapter: PageController maps renderer assets to TwMediaWikiStylesheet identities
IntegrationDesign.PageCache: TwPageCache stores identity/provenance only; sanitized CSS bytes are not cached
IntegrationDesign.RazorDelivery: Encoded same-origin link elements through the existing layout Styles section
IntegrationDesign.Ordering: Existing per-render first-accepted order and deduplication are preserved

Authorization.Model: Authorized source-page lookup using the existing TwSessionState Read permission evaluator
ChecksPerRequest: Signed token validity and bounded identity fields
Current viewer Read permission on the mapped source navigation
Exact source page/revision/target revision and source hash
Exact sanitizer policy and sanitized CSS hash
Authorization.CrossContextReuse: Rejected unless exact imported source identity and current authorization both match
Authorization.Verification: Partial: controller boundary tests cover fail-closed invalid/oversized identifiers; live authorized/private/revoked HTTP scenarios require the existing application permission/database harness

SourceRevisionBehavior.HistoricalSelection: Recorded SourceTimestampUtc; later revisions are not substituted
SourceRevisionBehavior.SuppressedRevisions: Excluded by the MySQL imported-revision resolver
SourceRevisionBehavior.StaleIdentity: 404 when any exact provenance, source, policy, or sanitized-output hash differs

Coverage: Historical TemplateStyles resolution and exact revision provenance
Sanitizer policy and sanitized CSS hash metadata
Invalid and oversized asset identifiers fail closed
nosniff and private no-store response headers on the delivery boundary
signed historical asset re-resolution through the actual PageController action
disposable loopback MVC routing through the actual TemplateStyles action
HTTP content type, cache-control, nosniff, sanitized-only body, and permission denial
actual PageController.Display imported-page model propagation of signed stylesheet URLs
sanitized CSS-only ContentResult with no raw source CSS

KnownLimitations: The focused suite includes a disposable loopback MVC host for the actual TemplateStyles action and permission boundary; broader cookie-authenticated page-render and permission-revocation scenarios remain application-host verification.
The delivery path uses the existing TightWiki page permission model; it does not invent MediaWiki-specific cross-tenant ACL or suppression policy.
The supported CSS subset remains the bounded CW-M5-001 subset, not full MediaWiki TemplateStyles parity.
This milestone does not certify historical MediaWiki parity, production migration readiness, Lua, Cargo, or the host worker.
RecommendedNextMilestone: Add an application-level HTTP test host with disposable authorization fixtures, then verify authorized/private/revoked source cases without changing production permission architecture.
